name: rql-query
title: Query / Read
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Read
summary: Read anything in the open scenes, prefabs, assets, console and project with one pipeline query.
description: Read anything in the open scenes, prefabs, assets, console and project with one pipeline query (`objects | where Light.intensity > 1 | select name, $path`). Filters, projects, sorts, groups and counts many objects in one call and answers as a compact text table. Use 'rql-schema' for the syntax and a type's members, 'rql-mutate' to change things.

name: rql-schema
title: Query / Schema
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Schema
summary: Syntax card of the query language plus the component types present in the open scenes; with typeName, the members and methods of that type.
description: Syntax card of the query language plus the component types present in the open scenes; with `typeName`, the members (type, read or write) and methods of that type. Call it before writing a 'rql-query' or 'rql-mutate' query you are unsure of.

name: rql-mutate
title: Query / Change
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Change
summary: Change many objects, components and assets in one query: objects | where name startswith "Enemy" | set Rigidbody.mass = 2.
description: Change many objects, components and assets in one query: `objects | where name startswith "Enemy" | set Rigidbody.mass = 2`. Also `call` methods, `add` components, `destroy` objects and create them with `new(...)`. All-or-nothing, one undo step, optional dry run.

name: scene-create
title: Scene / Create
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Create
summary: Create a new Unity scene asset and save it at the given .unity path.
description: Create a new Unity scene asset and save it at the given `.unity` path. Use 'rql-query' to inspect the resulting opened-scene set afterwards.

name: scene-open
title: Scene / Open
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Open
summary: Open a Unity scene asset in Single or Additive mode.
description: Open a Unity scene asset in Single or Additive mode. Returns the post-open list of all opened scenes. Use 'rql-query' to locate the scene asset first.

name: scene-save
title: Scene / Save
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Save
summary: Save an opened scene back to its asset file.
description: Save an opened scene back to its asset file (or to a new path when `path` is provided). When `openedSceneName` is empty, saves the currently active scene. Use 'rql-query' to find the scene name first.

name: scene-set-active
title: Scene / Set Active
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Set Active
summary: Mark an opened scene as the Editor's active scene.
description: Mark an opened scene as the Editor's active scene (the one new GameObjects are added to and that's used as the default for many operations). Use 'rql-query' to enumerate opened scenes first.

name: scene-unload
title: Scene / Unload
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Unload
summary: Unload an opened scene from the Unity Editor.
description: Unload an opened scene from the Unity Editor (`EditorSceneManager.CloseScene` in edit mode, `SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync` in play mode). Unsaved changes in that scene are lost — save with 'scene-save' first if needed. Use 'rql-query' to find the scene name first.

name: gameobject-component-list-all
title: GameObject / Component / List All
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Component / List All
summary: List the fully-qualified C# type names of every concrete UnityEngine.Component subclass available in the project.
description: List the fully-qualified C# type names of every concrete `UnityEngine.Component` subclass available in the project. Paginated (default 5/page, max 500). Use this to find a valid `componentName` for 'rql-mutate'.

name: physics-query
title: Physics / Query
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Physics / Query
summary: Raycast, spherecast, boxcast and sphere or box overlap against the colliders of the open scenes, in Edit mode, with no Play needed.
description: Raycast, spherecast, boxcast and sphere or box overlap against the colliders of the open scenes, in Edit mode, with no Play needed.

name: gameobject-duplicate
title: GameObject / Duplicate
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Duplicate
summary: Duplicate a batch of GameObjects in the currently opened Prefab or active Scene.
description: Duplicate a batch of GameObjects in the currently opened Prefab or active Scene. Marks each affected scene as dirty after duplication. Use 'rql-query' to locate the source GameObjects first.

name: physics-simulate
title: Physics / Simulate
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Physics / Simulate
summary: Run N physics steps on the open scenes in Edit mode and report which Rigidbodies moved, then put everything back.
description: Run N physics steps on the open scenes in Edit mode and report which Rigidbodies moved, then put everything back (or keep the result with undo).

name: assets-find-built-in
title: Assets / Find (Built-in)
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Find (Built-in)
summary: Search the built-in assets of the Unity Editor.
description: Search the built-in assets of the Unity Editor (located at Resources/unity_builtin_extra). Filters by name and/or type; built-in assets have no GUID so GUID-based lookups are not supported.

name: assets-shader-list-all
title: Assets / List Shaders
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: List Shaders
summary: List all shaders available in the project assets and packages, sorted by name.
description: List all shaders available in the project assets and packages, sorted by name. Use this to discover a valid `shaderName` for 'assets-material-create'.

name: scriptableobject-get
title: ScriptableObject / Get
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: ScriptableObject / Get
summary: Read the serialized properties of a ScriptableObject as property paths, types and values, including private [SerializeField] fields and array sizes.
description: Read the serialized properties of a ScriptableObject (or any asset) as property paths, types and values, including private [SerializeField] fields and array sizes.

name: assets-shader-get-data
title: Assets / Shader / Get Data
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Shader / Get Data
summary: Get detailed data about a shader asset.
description: Get detailed data about a shader asset — properties, subshaders, passes, compilation messages, and supported status. Supports token-saving path-scoped reads via `paths` or `viewQuery`. Use 'rql-query' with `t:Shader` or 'assets-shader-list-all' to locate the shader first.

name: assets-copy
title: Assets / Copy
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Copy
summary: Copy assets at given paths and store them at new paths.
description: Copy assets at given paths and store them at new paths. Refreshes the AssetDatabase at the end. Use 'rql-query' to locate the source assets first.

name: assets-create-folder
title: Assets / Create Folder
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Create Folder
summary: Create a new folder under a parent folder inside 'Assets/'.
description: Create a new folder under a parent folder inside 'Assets/'. The parent path must start with 'Assets/' and every intermediate folder in it must already exist. Refreshes the AssetDatabase at the end and returns the GUID(s) of the created folder(s).

name: assets-material-create
title: Assets / Create Material
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Create Material
summary: Create a new Material asset with default parameters at a given 'Assets/'-rooted path ending in '.mat'.
description: Create a new Material asset with default parameters at a given 'Assets/'-rooted path ending in '.mat'. Creates intermediate folders if missing. Use 'assets-shader-list-all' to find a valid `shaderName`.

name: assets-move
title: Assets / Move
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Move
summary: Move or rename assets at the given project paths.
description: Move or rename assets at the given project paths. Refreshes the AssetDatabase at the end. Moving/renaming can break references in scenes, prefabs and scripts — verify with 'rql-query' afterwards. Use 'rql-query' to locate the assets first.

name: assets-refresh
title: Assets / Refresh
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Refresh
summary: Refresh the Unity AssetDatabase.
description: Refresh the Unity AssetDatabase. Use after files were added or updated outside of the Unity API, or to force script recompilation when a '.cs' file changed. Returns a processing/success response and waits for compilation when triggered.

name: scriptableobject-create
title: ScriptableObject / Create
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: ScriptableObject / Create
summary: Create a ScriptableObject asset of a given type at an 'Assets/' path, optionally filling properties, with undo.
description: Create a ScriptableObject asset of a given type at an 'Assets/' path, optionally filling properties, with undo.

name: scriptableobject-set
title: ScriptableObject / Set
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: ScriptableObject / Set
summary: Set properties of a ScriptableObject asset by SerializedProperty path, including private [SerializeField] fields and array resize, with undo.
description: Set properties of a ScriptableObject asset by SerializedProperty path, including private [SerializeField] fields and array resize ('items.Array.size=3'), with undo.

name: assets-delete
title: Assets / Delete
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Delete
summary: Delete the assets at the given project paths.
description: Delete the assets at the given project paths. IRREVERSIBLE — deleted files are permanently removed from disk (no trash/undo), so verify with 'rql-query' first. Refreshes the AssetDatabase at the end.

name: assets-prefab-close
title: Assets / Prefab / Close
blurb: Open, edit and place prefabs.
label: Close
summary: Close the currently opened prefab edit stage.
description: Close the currently opened prefab edit stage. Optionally saves changes back to the prefab asset before closing. Pair with 'assets-prefab-open' to enter the edit mode first.

name: assets-prefab-create
title: Assets / Prefab / Create
blurb: Open, edit and place prefabs.
label: Create
summary: Create a Prefab at a project asset path.
description: Create a Prefab (or Prefab Variant) at a project asset path. Source can be a scene GameObject (`gameObjectRef`) or an existing prefab asset (`sourcePrefabAssetPath`). Creates intermediate folders if missing. Use 'rql-query' to locate the source GameObject first.

name: assets-prefab-instantiate
title: Assets / Prefab / Instantiate
blurb: Open, edit and place prefabs.
label: Instantiate
summary: Instantiate a prefab into the currently active scene at an optional position/rotation/scale, parented under an optional scene GameObject path.
description: Instantiate a prefab into the currently active scene at an optional position/rotation/scale, parented under an optional scene GameObject path. Use 'rql-query' to locate the prefab asset first.

name: assets-prefab-open
title: Assets / Prefab / Open
blurb: Open, edit and place prefabs.
label: Open
summary: Open the prefab edit stage for a prefab instance or prefab asset GameObject.
description: Open the prefab edit stage for a prefab instance or prefab asset GameObject. Modifications inside the edit stage propagate to all instances. Pair with 'assets-prefab-close' to exit the stage when done.

name: assets-prefab-save
title: Assets / Prefab / Save
blurb: Open, edit and place prefabs.
label: Save
summary: Save the currently opened prefab edit stage back to its prefab asset without exiting the stage.
description: Save the currently opened prefab edit stage back to its prefab asset without exiting the stage. Pair with 'assets-prefab-open' to enter the edit mode first.

name: reflection-method-find
title: Method C# / Find
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Method C# / Find
summary: Find C# methods across every loaded assembly by name / type / parameters.
description: Find C# methods across every loaded assembly by name / type / parameters — including private methods. Returns serialized `MethodData` entries usable as schemas for 'reflection-method-call'.

name: script-execute-history
title: Script / Execute History
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Execute History
summary: List the most recent 'script-execute' runs.
description: List the most recent 'script-execute' runs (up to 20, kept until the Editor closes, across domain reloads). Pass an id as `replayId` to 'script-execute' to run it again.

name: script-read
title: Script / Read
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Read
summary: Read a .cs script file and return its content as a string.
description: Read a `.cs` script file and return its content as a string. Supports a 1-based `lineFrom`/`lineTo` slice for partial reads. Pair with 'script-update-or-create' to write back.

name: script-validate
title: Script / Validate
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Validate
summary: Check C# code for errors without writing or running it.
description: Check C# code for errors without writing or running it. `semantic=true` (default) compiles against every loaded assembly like 'script-execute' does, so type and name errors show up; `semantic=false` only parses. Errors come back as `line:col CODE message`.

name: tests-list
title: Tests / List
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / List
summary: List the Unity tests of a mode, filtered by assembly, namespace, class or name text, with a per-assembly count.
description: List the Unity tests of a mode, filtered by assembly, namespace, class or name text, with a per-assembly count.

name: tests-result
title: Tests / Result
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / Result
summary: Status and result of the last 'tests-run'.
description: Status and result of the last 'tests-run' (job id, state, summary, failures). Poll it after 'tests-run' with async=true, or fetch a result the client timed out on. The record is kept in Library and survives domain reloads.

name: type-get-json-schema
title: Type / Get Json Schema
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Type / Get Json Schema
summary: Generate a JSON Schema for a C# type name via reflection.
description: Generate a JSON Schema for a C# type name via reflection. Supports primitives, enums, arrays, generic collections, dictionaries, and complex objects. Knobs control inclusion of nested `$defs` and whether type-level / property-level descriptions are emitted.

name: reflection-method-call
title: Method C# / Call
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Method C# / Call
summary: Call a C# method by reflection.
description: Call a C# method by reflection — including private methods. Requires a method schema obtained via 'reflection-method-find'. Supports static methods, instance methods (with optional target deserialization), and main-thread / off-thread execution.

name: script-execute
title: Script / Execute
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Execute
summary: Compiles and executes C# code dynamically using Roslyn.
description: Compiles and executes C# code dynamically using Roslyn. Supports a full-code mode (default) and a body-only mode — see the skill body for the difference and for how to pass Unity object references as parameters.

name: tests-run
title: Tests / Run
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / Run
summary: Execute Unity tests and return per-test results.
description: Execute Unity tests (`EditMode` or `PlayMode`) and return per-test results. Supports filtering by test assembly, namespace, class, and method. Refreshes the AssetDatabase first; defers execution across domain reloads if scripts changed. Precondition: every open scene must be saved — dirty scenes abort the run.

name: script-delete
title: Script / Delete
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Delete
summary: Delete one or more .cs script files from disk, refresh the AssetDatabase, and wait for Unity compilation to settle before delivering the final resu...
description: Delete one or more `.cs` script files from disk, refresh the AssetDatabase, and wait for Unity compilation to settle before delivering the final result via the request's `requestId`. IRREVERSIBLE — the file and its `.meta` are removed permanently (no undo), so inspect with 'script-read' before deleting.

name: script-update-or-create
title: Script / Update or Create
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Update or Create
summary: Write a .cs script file: create it, overwrite it with content, or edit it in place with oldText/newText.
description: Write a `.cs` script file: create it, overwrite it with `content`, or edit it in place with `oldText`/`newText`. `expectedSha256` refuses the write when the file changed since you read it. Code is checked before the write — invalid code is rejected and the file is left untouched. Refreshes the AssetDatabase and delivers the final result via `requestId` after Unity finishes the triggered compilation. Use 'script-read' (`includeSha256`) to inspect existing content first.

name: tests-clear
title: Tests / Clear
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / Clear
summary: Free a stuck tests-run slot so 'tests-run' can start again.
description: Free a stuck tests-run slot (a run that never reported back) so 'tests-run' can start again.

name: screenshot-camera
title: Screenshot / Camera
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Camera
summary: Capture a screenshot from a Unity Camera and return it as a PNG image for direct LLM inspection.
description: Capture a screenshot from a Unity `Camera` and return it as a PNG image for direct LLM inspection. Falls back to `Camera.main` (then any active camera) when `cameraRef` is null. Width and height are capped to keep response size manageable (`maxResolution`, default 1024; 0 = full size).

name: screenshot-editor-window
title: Screenshot / Editor Window
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Editor Window
summary: Capture any open Unity Editor window as the Editor draws it.
description: Capture any open Unity Editor window (Inspector, Console, a custom tool window, a floating window) as the Editor draws it. Pick it by title or type name; default is the focused window. Scaled to `maxResolution` (default 1024; 0 = full size).

name: screenshot-game-view
title: Screenshot / Game View
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Game View
summary: Capture a screenshot of the Unity Editor's Game View by reading its internal render texture directly.
description: Capture a screenshot of the Unity Editor's Game View by reading its internal render texture directly. Image size matches the current Game View resolution; the tool corrects Y-flip on DirectX / Metal so the output is always upright. Requires an open Game View window. Scaled to `maxResolution` (default 1024; 0 = full size).

name: screenshot-isolated
title: Screenshot / Isolated GameObject
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Isolated GameObject
summary: Render a target GameObject from a chosen camera angle with optional layer-based isolation, configurable background, multi-light setup via JSON, Com...
description: Render a target GameObject from a chosen camera angle with optional layer-based isolation, configurable background (solid/skybox/transparent), multi-light setup via JSON, Composite (2x2 Front/Right/Back/Top) and Surround (3x2, all six sides) modes. Returns a PNG image. When isolated=true, inactive children may briefly fire OnEnable — see the body for side-effect notes.

name: screenshot-scene-view
title: Screenshot / Scene View
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Scene View
summary: Capture a screenshot from the Unity Editor Scene View at the requested size.
description: Capture a screenshot from the Unity Editor Scene View at the requested size. Renders via the Scene View's active camera onto a temporary `RenderTexture`. Requires an open Scene View. Scaled to `maxResolution` (default 1024; 0 = full size).

name: ui-inspect-element
title: UI / Inspect Element
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Element
summary: Full DevTools-style detail of one visual element in an open EditorWindow: rects, measured text size, resolved styles, detected layout issues, ances...
description: Full DevTools-style detail of one visual element in an open EditorWindow: rects, measured text size, resolved styles (flex, size, margin/padding, overflow, whiteSpace, fontSize…), detected layout issues, ancestor chain, children, and the style sheets in scope for USS source mapping.

name: ui-inspect-issues
title: UI / Inspect Issues
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Issues
summary: Automatically scan the UI Toolkit tree of one or all open EditorWindows for layout defects: clipped text, children overflowing their parent, zero-s...
description: Automatically scan the UI Toolkit tree of one or all open EditorWindows for layout defects: clipped text (measured vs available size), children overflowing their parent, zero-size elements with content. Returns a structured issue list with index paths ready for 'ui-inspect-element'.

name: ui-inspect-tree
title: UI / Inspect Tree
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Tree
summary: Dump the UI Toolkit element tree of an open EditorWindow as indented text.
description: Dump the UI Toolkit element tree of an open EditorWindow as indented text — one line per element with index path, type, #name, .classes, world rect, text preview, and inline layout-issue flags (TEXT-CLIPPED, OVERFLOWS-PARENT, ZERO-SIZE). The DOM-inspector replacement for screenshots.

name: ui-inspect-windows
title: UI / Inspect Windows
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Windows
summary: List every EditorWindow currently alive in the Unity Editor.
description: List every EditorWindow currently alive in the Unity Editor — type, title, rect, focus, dock state, and whether it has a UI Toolkit element tree. Entry point for the ui-inspect tool family: pick a window here, then drill in with 'ui-inspect-tree'.

name: uitoolkit-render
title: UI Toolkit / Render
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI Toolkit / Render
summary: Render a UIDocument, a .uxml asset or a PanelSettings asset to a PNG at a chosen size, in Edit mode, without Game View or play mode.
description: Render a UIDocument (scene object path), a .uxml asset or a PanelSettings asset to a PNG at a chosen size, in Edit mode, without Game View or play mode. Leaves scenes and assets as they were.

name: ui-inspect-pick
title: UI / Inspect Pick
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Pick
summary: Interactive element picker, like the web DevTools inspect cursor: activates pick mode on an open EditorWindow, the user hovers and clicks the misbe...
description: Interactive element picker, like the web DevTools inspect cursor: activates pick mode on an open EditorWindow, the user hovers (live highlight) and clicks the misbehaving element, and the tool returns that element's full detail (index path, styles, detected issues) via the deferred requestId result.

name: uitoolkit-document-attach
title: UI Toolkit / Attach Document
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI Toolkit / Attach Document
summary: Put a UIDocument on a scene object with a UXML source and a PanelSettings asset.
description: Put a UIDocument on a scene object (created when missing) with a UXML source and a PanelSettings asset (an existing one, or a new one with the default theme). One undo step.

name: uitoolkit-write
title: UI Toolkit / Write File
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI Toolkit / Write File
summary: Create or edit a UI Toolkit .uxml or .uss file under Assets/: create, overwrite, append, or replace one piece of text.
description: Create or edit a UI Toolkit .uxml or .uss file under Assets/: create, overwrite, append, or replace one piece of text. UXML must be well-formed XML and USS must have balanced braces, otherwise nothing is written. Imports the asset and returns its size.

name: editor-application-get-state
title: Editor / Application / Get State
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Application / Get State
summary: Return the current state of UnityEditor.EditorApplication.
description: Return the current state of `UnityEditor.EditorApplication` — playmode, paused state, compilation state, and related flags.

name: console-get-logs
title: Console / Get Logs
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Console / Get Logs
summary: Retrieve Unity Editor logs from the MCP plugin's LogCollector, optionally filtered by log type or time window.
description: Retrieve Unity Editor logs from the MCP plugin's `LogCollector`, optionally filtered by log type or time window. Useful for debugging and monitoring Editor activity.

name: console-get-logs-page
title: Console / Get Logs Page
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Console / Get Logs Page
summary: Read console logs page by page with a cursor: each result has nextCursor; pass it as afterCursor to get only logs written since, in order and witho...
description: Read console logs page by page with a cursor: each result has `nextCursor`; pass it as `afterCursor` to get only logs written since, in order and without gaps. Also says when it cut results (`truncated`, `hint`).

name: settings-get
title: Settings / Get
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Settings / Get
summary: Read a project settings area as property paths with types and values.
description: Read a project settings area (player, quality, physics, physics2d, time, editor, graphics, tagmanager) as property paths with types and values.

name: editor-application-set-state
title: Editor / Application / Set State
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Application / Set State
summary: Start / stop / pause the Unity Editor 'playmode'.
description: Start / stop / pause the Unity Editor 'playmode'. Use 'editor-application-get-state' to inspect the current state first. Throws if the project currently has compilation errors.

name: editor-selection-set
title: Editor / Selection / Set
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Selection / Set
summary: Set the current Selection in the Unity Editor to the provided objects.
description: Set the current Selection in the Unity Editor to the provided objects. All `ObjectRef`s must resolve to existing Unity objects; otherwise the call throws. Read the current selection first with 'rql-query' (`selection`).

name: settings-build-scenes
title: Settings / Build Scenes
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Settings / Build Scenes
summary: List and edit the scenes in Build Settings: add, remove, enable, disable, move or replace the whole list.
description: List and edit the scenes in Build Settings: add, remove, enable, disable, move or replace the whole list.

name: settings-set
title: Settings / Set
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Settings / Set
summary: Set one or more project settings values by property path, with undo.
description: Set one or more project settings values (player, quality, physics, physics2d, time, editor, graphics) by property path, with undo.

name: settings-tags
title: Settings / Tags and Layers
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Settings / Tags and Layers
summary: List, add and remove tags, user layers and sorting layers of the project, with undo.
description: List, add and remove tags, user layers (8-31) and sorting layers of the project, with undo.

name: editor-undo
title: Editor / Undo
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Undo
summary: Undoes or redoes the last Editor undo groups, like Edit > Undo / Redo, and returns the name of each group.
description: Undoes or redoes the last Editor undo groups, like Edit > Undo / Redo, and returns the name of each group. Only changes recorded in the undo stack are reverted (not disk writes or saved assets). Editor-changing: it can undo another person's work, so it follows the editor lock.

name: watch
title: Editor / Watch Playtest
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Watch Playtest
summary: Learn a playtest workflow by watching the user play it, then replay it fast: watch start puts a cyan frame on the Game View and records every input...
description: Learn a playtest workflow by watching the user play it, then replay it fast: `watch start` puts a cyan frame on the Game View and records every input, UI click (object path, label, listeners), player position, scene change, console error and a frame every 2 s until the user exits Play mode or presses STOP; the user then describes the workflow in chat. Holds the read-ask-playbook-replay loop: read summary.md and contact sheets, read the code behind the clicks, ask only what is missing, write a playbook, replay with code shortcuts, UI clicks, walking and teleports only for long distances, and report stuck or fallen players. Use when the user invokes matrix-watch or asks to record, show, teach or replay a playtest flow.

name: console-clear-logs
title: Console / Clear Logs
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Console / Clear Logs
summary: Clear the MCP log cache and the Unity Editor Console window.
description: Clear the MCP log cache (used by 'console-get-logs') and the Unity Editor Console window. Useful for isolating logs to a specific action by clearing the slate first.

name: package-list
title: Package Manager / List Installed
blurb: Search, install and remove packages.
label: Package Manager / List Installed
summary: List all UPM packages installed in the Unity project.
description: List all UPM packages installed in the Unity project — name, version, source, description. Optionally filter by source (registry, embedded, local, git, built-in, local tarball), by name/display/description substring, and by direct-dependency-only.

name: package-search
title: Package Manager / Search
blurb: Search, install and remove packages.
label: Package Manager / Search
summary: Search Unity's package registry plus locally installed packages by query string.

name: package-add

Modifies `manifest.json` and triggers package resolution; may also trigger a domain reload — the final result is delivered after the reload via the request's `requestId`. Built-in packages and packages that are dependencies of others cannot be removed. Removing a package whose API is used by project code breaks compilation — check usages with 'package-list' (and search the codebase) first.

description: List all Feeder MCP tools registered in the connected Unity Editor instance, including disabled ones (see `enabled`); only a core set is on by default, so use this to find a tool, then enable it with tool-set-enabled-state. Optional regex filter matches against tool name, description, and argument names/descriptions. Use the `includeDescription` / `includeInputs` toggles to control the response size.

name: tool-set-enabled-state
title: Tool / Set Enabled State
blurb: Let agents manage their own skills.
label: Tool / Set Enabled State
summary: Enable or disable MCP tools by name in batch.
description: Enable or disable MCP tools by name in batch. Persists the change via `MatrixPluginEditor.Instance.Save()` only when at least one tool actually flipped. Returns per-input success flags plus optional operation logs.

name: batch-execute
title: Batch / Execute
label: Execute
summary: Runs up to 100 different Unity tools in order in one call, for example create an object, add a component, assign a material.
description: Runs up to 100 different Unity tools in order in one call, for example create an object, add a component, assign a material. All commands are validated first (unknown, disabled or forbidden tools run nothing). stopOnError (default true) stops at the first failing command. atomic=true makes the batch one undo step ('Matrix batch') and, if any command fails, reverts it with the undo stack (implies stopOnError); only undo-recorded changes revert, not disk writes or saved assets. Not allowed inside a batch: batch-execute, tool-call, editor-health and the editor-lock tools. Tools that finish later (compile, assets-refresh, test runs) count as an error and stop the batch: run them alone. Limits: the batch counts as an editor-changing call for the editor lock even when every command only reads, and the commands skip your client's per-tool permission rules, only batch-execute itself is checked.
